description: "What is [company]'s ASN" / "find the AS number for [organisation]" / "search ASNs by name" — resolve an organisation or network name to its AS numbers and prefixes using RIPEstat's resource autocomplete. Returns candidate ASNs with their holder descriptions, so it is the lookup step BEFORE as_overview / ripestat_announced_prefixes / asn_neighbours when you only know the company name. Matches on the registered AS name and holder description across all five RIRs.

query.description: Organisation or network name to search for (e.g. "cloudflare", "deutsche telekom")

title: Ripestat Asn Search
